name: as-neural
_comment_network: Instances is VPC-only. These subnets need a route to the storm server — a NAT gateway for a public server, or same-VPC placement.
_comment_compute_bounds: max_volume_size_gb bounds the IAM grant for EBS volumes the operator role may create. It does not size anything; AgentCore takes the size from the AMI. Raise it if a persona needs a large working set.
_comment_lifecycle: A session is a RUNNING instance and bills while idle. 3600s idle timeout keeps a forgotten panel from running all month; max_lifetime is the AgentCore ceiling of 14 days.

personas.name: project-lead
personas._comment: Scope each persona to only the models it actually uses — one runtime per persona exists so their IAM can differ.
personas._comment_invite: Do NOT put the invite token here. It is a single-use credential and this file belongs in git. Inject it at deploy time from Secrets Manager or your CI secret store into AGENTSTORMING_INVITE_TOKEN.

personas.name: aws-mlops
personas._comment_iam: Extra statements land in this persona's execution role only. Keep them narrow — this is the persona that can spend money.
